description:
Aggregate battery metrics across the entire fleet, or across one brand when
`brand` is provided, optionally restricted to one `country` / `continent`.
Returns mean / median / p25 / p75 / min / max for the same set of metrics as
`model_summary`. Use this for fleet-wide baselines that a single device or
model can be compared against. A region scope with fewer than 5 devices is
refused; to compare several regions at once use `region_summary`.

brand.description: Optional lowercase brand identifier. If set, aggregates across that brand only; otherwise across the entire fleet.

continent.description: Optional continent, case-insensitive: 'Africa', 'Antarctica', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'North America', 'Oceania' or 'South America'. Keeps only devices whose time zone lies there. Combine with `country` for an intersection.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'FR', 'IN', 'US'), case-insensitive. Keeps only devices whose time zone belongs to that country. The region comes from the phone's time-zone setting, not GPS / IP.
